purpose: freeze the census METRICS before any distribution is observed, so metrics are not chosen after seeing results

FLOOR_RATIONALE_GUARD.the_floor_IS_for: whether a claim has sufficient X-side evaluability, positive support and breadth to be a statistically meaningful candidate at all
FLOOR_RATIONALE_GUARD.explicitly: sizing a floor to obtain a desired k would be POST-HOC MULTIPLICITY ENGINEERING
FLOOR_RATIONALE_GUARD.acceptable_outcomes: the floor may cut a great deal, or almost nothing — both are legitimate
FLOOR_RATIONALE_GUARD.retracted_framing: an earlier statement that 'the floor will be doing real work in reducing it'

CLAIM_EVALUATION_RULES.EVALUABLE: source(A) @ M_i == AVAILABLE_VALID AND source(B) @ M_{i+1} == AVAILABLE_VALID
CLAIM_EVALUATION_RULES.POSITIVE: EVALUABLE AND A == TRUE AND B == TRUE
CLAIM_EVALUATION_RULES.PAIR_UNAVAILABLE: either side non-valid — NEVER counted as FALSE

PER_CLAIM_METRICS.positive_rate_status: SUPPORT DESCRIPTOR ONLY — no outcome or edge interpretation

HOLDOUT.warning: 12 sessions — episode/opportunity counts, NOT independent temporal replications

POSITION_PAIR_IS_CLAIM_IDENTITY.rule: A@M1->B@M2, A@M2->B@M3, A@M3->B@M4 are THREE DISTINCT CLAIMS
POSITION_PAIR_IS_CLAIM_IDENTITY.forbidden: aggregating their support under a single A->B for eligibility purposes
POSITION_PAIR_IS_CLAIM_IDENTITY.permitted: an aggregate summary as a DIAGNOSTIC only; the floor acts at CLAIM level

ZERO_SUPPORT_RETENTION.rule: claims with evaluable_pairs = 0 and positive_pairs = 0 MUST NOT disappear
ZERO_SUPPORT_RETENTION.threat: an SQL inner join or GROUP BY silently dropping zero-support claims

PERMITTED_BREAKDOWNS.forbidden: any new clustering or grouping invented after seeing support

THREE_DISTINCT_FAILURE_MODES.rule: a single minimum-positive-count floor is NOT sufficient
THREE_DISTINCT_FAILURE_MODES.LOW_EVALUABILITY: the claim is rarely measurable at all
THREE_DISTINCT_FAILURE_MODES.LOW_POSITIVE_SUPPORT: measurable, but the TRUE pair is very rare
THREE_DISTINCT_FAILURE_MODES.LOW_BREADTH: positive occurrences exist but on very few securities

worked_contrast.point: identical positive counts, entirely different evidence topology

CONCENTRATION_POLICY.must_not: be applied automatically as an exclusion during the census

STOP_AFTER: census — the floor is specified in a SEPARATE later artifact

DEFLATION_NOTE.observation: the 45,387 claims are heavily clustered by shared source features
DEFLATION_NOTE.status: clustered-CI / DSR belong to the POST-Y statistical layer
DEFLATION_NOTE.guard: the support floor must NOT be tuned to make later multiplicity more comfortable
